items.name: Stone
items.title: Stone Ore in The Forge: Stats and Location
items.h1: Stone Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Uses
items.desc: Stone ore in The Forge: a Common 1-in-1 drop from Pebbles in Stonewake's Cross, with a 0.2x multiplier, a $3 sell price, and no trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Stone is the first Common ore most players pick up in The Forge. It drops from every Pebble in Stonewake's Cross, so it is easy to stock, and it has a 0.2x multiplier.
items.how_to_get: Mine Pebbles in Stonewake's Cross, the starting area. Multiple sources list Stone's drop chance as a guaranteed 1/1 from those Pebbles, and they do not list it on Rocks or Boulders.
items.uses: Stone has no trait. Its multiplier is 0.2x, the lowest in this set, and it sells for $3. It is early-game filler for forging practice; later ores in this list have higher multipliers. For the mine-forge-sell loop, see the beginner guide and the forging guide.

items.name: Poopite
items.title: Poopite Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Trait
items.h1: Poopite Ore in The Forge: Drop Chance and Trait
items.desc: Poopite in The Forge: an Epic 1-in-131 drop from Pebbles, Rocks and Boulders in Stonewake's Cross, 1.2x multiplier, $18, and a Bad Smell trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Poopite is an Epic ore from Stonewake's Cross, and it is the only World 1 ore with a confirmed trait. Sources agree it drops from Pebbles, Rocks, and Boulders at 1-in-131, with a 1.2x multiplier, an $18 sell price, and the Bad Smell trait.
items.how_to_get: Mine Pebbles, Rocks, or Boulders in Stonewake's Cross. The official Forge Wiki, Game8, Destructoid, and BloxInformer all list a 1/131 drop chance from those nodes.
items.uses: Poopite has the Bad Smell trait and the highest confirmed multiplier in Stonewake's Cross at 1.2x. It sells for $18. Two or more sources agree the trait creates a poison cloud around the player for 5 seconds, deals 15% poison damage, makes enemies flee, has a 15 second cooldown, and activates when health is low. The official wiki and Destructoid list the trigger as below 35% HP; see the source note below for a wording disagreement. For early mining and forging, see the pickaxe progression guide and the forging guide.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer
unverified: Trait trigger: the official Forge Wiki Poopite page and Destructoid (January 8, 2026) say Bad Smell activates below 35% HP. Game8 (February 22, 2026) writes "below 35 HP" without a percent sign. BloxInformer lists 15% Health. This page uses 35% HP, the figure with two clear sources, and flags the disagreement.

The official wiki describes the cloud as dealing 15% of base weapon damage per second for 5 seconds. Game8 and BloxInformer list 15% poison for 5 seconds but do not mention per-second ticks or base weapon damage, so those extra details are not treated as confirmed.

items.name: Fichillium
items.title: Fichillium Ore in The Forge: Lucky Block Drop
items.h1: Fichillium Ore in The Forge: Lucky Block Drop
items.desc: Fichillium in The Forge: a Relic 1-in-1 drop from Lucky Blocks in Stonewake's Cross, with a 0x multiplier, a $0 sell price, and no trait. See the stats!
items.lead: Fichillium is a Relic ore from Stonewake's Cross. The official Forge Wiki, Game8, and BloxInformer list it as Relic, with a 1/1 chance, a 0x multiplier, a $0 sell price, and no trait. The official wiki and Game8 say it comes from Lucky Blocks; BloxInformer describes a hidden house location instead (see below).
items.how_to_get: It comes from Lucky Blocks in Stonewake's Cross. The official Forge Wiki and Game8 both list a guaranteed 1/1 drop from those blocks. The official wiki's Lucky Block page says the block is a hidden mineable rock that only spawns inside a specific hut and does not appear in the open world. BloxInformer also calls Fichillium a secret ore from a hidden section of a house in Stonewake's Cross, but it does not name Lucky Block. Destructoid's World 1 table (January 8, 2026) does not include Fichillium.
items.uses: Fichillium has no trait, a 0x multiplier, and a $0 sell price, so sources do not treat it as a forging or selling ore. The official wiki also says it can be useful for creating Golemites, because the game treats Relic-tier ores as high quality for that; we did not find a second source, so that use is not listed as confirmed.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer
unverified: Source: the official Forge Wiki and Game8 (February 22, 2026) list Lucky Block in Stonewake's Cross. BloxInformer describes a secret ore from a hidden section of a house there and does not name Lucky Block. The official wiki's Lucky Block page adds that the block only spawns inside a specific hut (it mentions a hidden roof). We treat Lucky Block in Stonewake's Cross as confirmed. We do not treat the exact hut or roof steps as confirmed.
Golemite use: only the official Forge Wiki Fichillium page mentions creating Golemites. We did not find a second source, so that use is not confirmed.
Destructoid's All Ores in The Forge guide (updated January 8, 2026) does not include Fichillium in its World 1 table, so it is not used as a confirming source for this ore.

items.lead: Demonite is a Mythic ore from the Forgotten Kingdom. Sources agree it drops from Volcanic Rock at 1-in-3666, with a 5.5x multiplier and an $82.50 sell price. The official wiki, Game8, and Destructoid agree the Armor trait includes a 25% chance to apply Burn when you take damage. Some sources also describe a second burn effect whose numbers do not line up.
items.how_to_get: Mine Volcanic Rock in the Forgotten Kingdom. The official Forge Wiki, Game8, Destructoid, and BloxInformer all list a 1/3666 drop chance from those nodes. Some sources label this rarity Mythical; this site uses Mythic, the official wiki's rarity name.
items.uses: Demonite's confirmed Armor trait is a 25% chance to apply Burn when taking damage. It has a 5.5x multiplier and an $82.50 sell price. See the forging guide and the beginner guide for how mined ores fit the crafting loop.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer
unverified: A second burn effect is described differently across sources: the official wiki lists a 15% chance to apply Burn for 2 seconds, dealing 20% of base weapon damage per second (under Armor Traits). BloxInformer describes a 15% on-hit chance to deal 20% of weapon damage as Burn over 2 seconds, plus a Demon's Backfire passive on Armor. Destructoid combines a 15% on-hit / 20% burn for 2 seconds with the 25% when-damaged effect. Game8 only describes the 25% when-damaged effect. Because those extra numbers do not agree, they are not part of the confirmed trait.

items.desc: Darkryte ore in The Forge: a Mythic 1-in-6655 Forgotten Kingdom drop from Volcanic Rock, 6.3x multiplier, $94.50 sell price, 15% dodge on Armor. See the stats!
items.lead: Darkryte is a Mythic ore from the Forgotten Kingdom. The official wiki, Game8, and Destructoid agree it drops from Volcanic Rock at 1-in-6655, with a 6.3x multiplier, a $94.50 sell price, and a 15% chance to dodge an attack on Armor. Some sources label this rarity Mythical; this site uses Mythic, the official wiki's rarity name.
items.how_to_get: Mine Volcanic Rock in the Forgotten Kingdom. The official Forge Wiki, Game8, and Destructoid all list a 1/6655 drop chance from those nodes. BloxInformer lists the same nodes, multiplier, price, and a dodge trait, but gives the chance as 1/5555 (see below).
items.uses: Darkryte's confirmed Armor trait is a 15% chance to dodge an attack. It has a 6.3x multiplier and a $94.50 sell price. See the forging guide and the beginner guide for how mined ores fit the crafting loop.
items.image_credit: Item icon: The Forge Wiki (forgewiki.org), game artwork © the game's developer
unverified: Drop chance: BloxInformer lists 1/5555. The official Forge Wiki, Game8, and Destructoid list 1/6655, so this page uses 1/6655.
The official wiki item page also lists Crystals as a location alongside Volcanic Rock. Game8, Destructoid, and BloxInformer list only Volcanic Rock, so Crystals is not listed under Obtained from.

The official wiki also mentions a small movement speed buff with the dodge (Phantom Step). Game8, Destructoid, and BloxInformer describe the 15% dodge (Destructoid and BloxInformer mention turning into a shadow) but do not confirm the speed buff, so the buff is not part of the confirmed trait.
